part.text:
Fixed. The trailing slash redirect status default in `axum/src/routing/mod.rs:121` was changed from `StatusCode::MOVED_PERMANENTLY` (301) to `StatusCode::PERMANENT_REDIRECT` (308), preserving the request method and body on redirects.

Verification:
- All 127 `axum` lib + integration tests pass, including the routing test asserting `StatusCode::PERMANENT_REDIRECT` (axum/src/routing/tests/mod.rs:408).
- The 3 failing doctests are pre-existing environment issues (feature-gated `headers`/`TypedHeader` docs), unrelated to this change.
